notes.title: THE TRAIN HAS ARRIVED!
notes.notes:
After 6 months of designing, prototyping, and developing, our game is finally available to the public! 

[i]Shayride Studios[/i], a 4 person team, is proud to present you [i]RED TREES RAIL. CO. [/i]

Follow your dreams of operating a steam train. As you transport passengers, you may experience frights in your journey.

WARNING: This experience is difficult at first for those not familiar with locomotive controls. This experience is also best played standing in VR, utilizing the teleporting areas to move.
